newsitem.title: USA: Oldest senator Strom Thurmond in hospital with flu.
newsitem.headline: Oldest senator Strom Thurmond in hospital with flu.

text.p: Sen. Strom Thurmond, at 94 the oldest member of Congress, was hospitalized with the flu over the weekend but expected to be released in time to open the Senate Monday morning, an aide said Sunday.
"It's nothing more than the flu -- the same one everyone in the office has had," said press secretary Chris Cimka.
She said the South Carolina Republican was admitted to Walter Reed Medical Centre last week but was not sure what day because she had been at home with the flu herself.
He was advised to enter the hospital because "he's 94 years old and he lives alone," Cimka said.
"It's nothing more than the flu," she said. "You can't keep him down."
